behavior.enabled: Forces reduced motion, Large text, visible cue explanations, muted audio, and reduced notifications; locks conflicting presentation/audio controls.
behavior.disabled: Restores the prior local presentation/audio preferences captured when the mode was enabled.
behavior.storage: The mode preference and pre-mode mute/notification snapshot use the existing browser-local/session-local presentation settings boundary.
behavior.fallback: Written decisions, observations, results, history, and debrief remain available when the mode or audio bridge is unavailable.

authority_boundary: The mode is local presentation state; it does not enter commands, validation, transitions, stochastic inputs, immutable history, replay, host persistence, or simulation authority.
limits: This does not establish universal accessibility, educational usability, audio usefulness, or classroom approval.
It is not a new host game mode and does not create a new observation or debrief route.
Human accessibility and educational review remain separate gates.
